description: Scenario tests for instagram-growth. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-growth-system
evals.input: My Instagram isn't growing. I'm a solo founder posting a few times a week. Help me grow.
expect: reads brand-profile, social-strategy, and audience first
diagnoses which stage of the growth loop is stuck (reach / follow-conversion / retention / sends)
centers Reels as the primary non-follower reach engine and watch time + sends as the key signals
routes the fixes to the right skills (reels-script, profile-optimization, content-calendar, etc.) instead of generic tips
ties cadence to sustainable capacity and judges progress via native Insights, not WoopSocial analytics

evals.name: diagnose-the-broken-stage
evals.input: My Reels get thousands of views but I barely gain followers. What's wrong?
expect: identifies the broken stage as follow-conversion (the profile isn't converting reach), not reach
routes to profile-optimization as the primary fix
does not just tell them to post more or get more views

evals.name: sends-lever
evals.input: How do I actually get my Reels to reach new people?
expect: emphasizes sends-per-reach (DM shares) as the dominant signal for non-follower reach (worth 3-5x likes)
advises engineering send-worthy content (relatable, useful, conversation-starting) plus a strong 3-second hook for watch time
does not tell them to chase likes or buy engagement

evals.name: originality-gate-pushback
evals.input: I'll just repost my best TikToks to Instagram to grow faster.
expect: flags that TikTok-watermarked and reposted content is throttled/excluded from recommendations (originality gate)
advises creating native, original Instagram versions (remove watermarks, made-for-IG)
explains heavy reposting can exclude the account from recommendations

evals.name: vanity-followers-pushback
evals.input: Just get me to 10k followers fast — buy some if needed.
expect: refuses buying followers / engagement pods (fake engagement hurts reach and risks the account)
reframes the goal toward reach, sends-per-reach, saves, profile visits, and leads over raw follower count
frames follower count as a vanity metric

evals.name: no-guarantee-viral
evals.input: Guarantee me viral growth in 30 days.
expect: does not promise virality or guaranteed growth (luck/distribution are partly outside control)
frames growth as a compounding system that stacks the odds, not a guaranteed outcome
sets honest expectations

evals.name: niche-clarity
evals.input: I post about marketing, fitness, crypto, and my dog. Why won't it grow?
expect: explains the algorithm must clearly categorize the account to recommend it (niche clarity is a ranking edge)
recommends tightening to a clear lane
ties this to topic signals (caption/on-screen/audio keywords) and consistency

evals.name: cadence-and-no-analytics
evals.input: How often should I post and how do I know it's working?
expect: recommends a sustainable cadence matched to capacity (consistency over volume) and routes to content-calendar
does not claim WoopSocial provides analytics
points to native Instagram Insights (sends-per-reach, saves, watch time, profile visits, follower vs non-follower reach) or qualitative review
